microcosm: Esc goes back to the title screen.
atoms: The best score per mode is now saved and shown as "Rekord" on the mode menu.
castle: Level sets 3 and 4 play your own levels saved in Castedit; extra keys (Space, X, Shift, C, V, F1–F4 to save); Esc back to the title; death returns there.
castedit: Saving your own levels to slots 3 and 4 (the originals 1 and 2 stay read-only), export/import of level files (Ctrl+E/Ctrl+O) and playing them in Castle are new; added help overlay and Esc back; a key tap moves one cell.
siege: New setup page where either castle can be played by the computer opponent that the original contains but never starts (it only sends a warrior about every 1.3 seconds, so it is easy to beat). Esc goes back to the setup page.
s-type: Esc goes back to the menu; game over and winning level 2 fade back to the menu; menu pointer now matches the selected option; player 1 fires with Space on the web.
huhnshot: When time runs out, a results screen (score, birds, accuracy) appears with click to play again.
lommings: Skills and speed/pause/nuke can be clicked on the panel; added a "Try again!" banner on failure and an end screen after the last level. New level select screen: start at any of the 13 levels (level 1 is selected, as before) and go on from there in the original order; Esc goes back to it.
stranded: Added a red hero dot on the radar.
siedler: Settlers can no longer walk off the map edge and vanish.
heatfighter: Added a setup screen (characters, human or computer), K.O. at zero life with rematch, Esc to the menu, life/mana bars and a floor line; Eigen's fireballs can now be blocked by Template and Chain. Runs at 60 ticks per second instead of the original's 100, so everything moves at 60% of the original speed.
miniship: Esc or Backspace cleanly returns to the menu; player A fires with Right Shift on the web.
gigamaze: Player 1 fires with Space on the web.
canonball-riding: Esc after game over returns to the title screen.
wormbattlewarriors: The original was unfinished: added turns (Space ends the turn), attacking by moving into an enemy, a win when one side has no worms left, and a turn indicator; fighters can no longer dig.
baller: Added a level list with all 8 levels, Esc back to the list and Enter to retry after a level ends.
bunnyjumpers: New options screen to add 0–50 extra bunnies, as in the original's commented-out spawn loop (they have no controls and just get in the way); Esc in the game goes back to it.
pingpong: New options screen before each match: number of balls, ball speed, points needed to win, the original's unused classic one-ball mode, and a computer player for either bat (from the original's unused AI code). Enter or Space after a win, or Esc, goes back to it.
ship-duel: Added a winner banner and Esc/Enter back to the settings screen; the settings pointer no longer runs off the list. Fixed shots getting stuck in shields, moved player 1's explosion shot to the Down arrow (End clashed with player 3), and corrected two swapped settings labels.
thursday-panzers: Player 2 now really controls the red team (broken in the original); added a winner message, and Esc goes back to the setup screen. New setup screen before each match: team sizes and each team's tank life, damage and speed (defaults are the original's), plus an optional reinforcements mode from the original's commented-out code that brings in a new tank for each team every second.
sniper: New options screen: number of snipers, rifle, minigun and grenade-launcher snipers (the last two built from the original's commented-out code) and balloon rate; the defaults are the original game. Esc goes back to it.
hatsch1: Ship 3 now starts bottom left instead of on top of ship 2; Enter restarts the round.
runner: Enter or Space restarts; the FOUL text now stays on screen.
decathlon: Added a one-line control hint at the bottom.
ballkill: The hiscore is now loaded at start; after Game Over the game restarts instead of quitting.
tron: Added a winner/draw message and Enter or Space to restart.
fort: Added a "Schaden" damage counter, since the original showed no feedback on hits. Enemies arrive 10 times less often (a pair every ~4.2 s instead of every ~0.4 s), because the original swarm was too thick.
rubik: Nothing; this is a faithful port.
panzers: New options screen that turns the original sandbox into a duel: tanks take a chosen number of hits (default 30), turn into wrecks and a winner is shown. The original sandbox and its grass camouflage, which makes the tanks nearly invisible, are still there as options.
snake: The play field moved into the frame (the original drew it outside); the topscore is now saved.
kochkurve: Nothing; this is a faithful port.
rotators: Everything interactive is new: options screen for your own patterns, pause, clear, restart, random pattern and on-screen key text (options are saved).
mandelbrot: Added a key hint line (H hides it) and keypad +/- as extra zoom keys.
antjumper: Added an options screen (Langton's ant and other rules, more ants, speed, canvas, wrap), mouse drag/wheel, pause, restart and a controls bar; on the web Ctrl no longer zooms out. Fixed the original's colour-table slip, so the ant is now a real Langton's ant (RL) by default; the original's straight-line bug is still selectable in the options.
balls: Added R to restart, with a hint line.
